name: Toshiba (Vestel Cosmos170, yeoksam, MediaTek), Spain
warnings: Live TV app:    com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter (.nav.TurnkeyUiMainActivity) — NEVER disable it.

With their apps disabled the buttons simply do nothing; no launcher key service can remap them. - Volume keys do reach Android (KEY_VOLUMEUP/DOWN on event0), but the firmware changes the volume before the accessibility filter and never passes them on, so no app (InputKeyService included) can replace the system volume slider. - The TV closes Wi-Fi (and ADB with it) in standby.
